section.title: What to validate
section.p: Ensure every inline points to a key that is defined by a corresponding in the active publishing context.
For consistent resolution, keep shared keys in the project’s and make sure that map is used as the primary build input.

section.title: Common resolution scope
section.p: Keys defined in a parent are available to child topicrefs, so placing core terms (like ) in the root map reduces duplication.
